Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], an '''unidentified [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] warehouse''' was taken over by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and other bounty hunters including [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in the disguise of [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]].

==History==
The bounty hunters killed all the mechanics who were working in the warehouse, and started their [[Plan to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine/Legends|plan]] upon kidnapping [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] on the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]]. [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], [[Twazzi/Legends|Twazzi]], [[Derrown/Legends|Derrown]], Bane and Kenobi were handled a [[Multispectrum disguise suite|holographic disguise matrix]] so they could bear a particular disguise, while [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] and Dooku remained in the background, waiting for the outcome of their plan.
